query: 客户隐私保护政策 客户隐私保护政策 衡量企业在个人信息收集、使用、存储和共享方面的治理水平。重点考察“最小必要”原则的落地、用户授权机制、数据留存期限、第三方共享管理及隐私安全事件的应急响应。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的隐私政策，严格遵循“最小必要”原则；建立了动态授权与撤回机制；明确了数据留存与销毁时限；对第三方数据共享有严苛的审计要求，并披露了具体的隐私漏洞响应与补偿机制。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的隐私政策及用户协议，包含基础的收集与使用告知，具备数据加密等保护措施，但缺乏深度的第三方穿透管理、明确的留存期限或用户撤回授权的操作指南。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式隐私政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视信息安全”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：隐私保护机制覆盖 >80% 的业务线、APP/平台终端及经营地区，且通过了相关的外部审计（如 ISO 27701）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心 APP 具备政策而其他子业务线存在盲区，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 隐私政策 个人信息保护 最小必要 用户授权 数据留存 第三方共享 隐私事件响应 撤回同意 个人信息保护法 PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 privacy policy personal data protection data minimization user consent data retention third-party sharing privacy incident response PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 是否有正式客户/用户隐私政策或用户协议？ 是否披露个人信息收集和使用告知、最小必要原则及用户授权机制？ 用户能否撤回同意、注销账户、访问、更正或删除个人信息？ 是否采用数据加密、脱敏或访问控制？ 数据留存与销毁时限如何规定？ 第三方共享及SDK如何审核和约束？ 隐私事件响应、补偿、外部认证及覆盖范围是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '客户隐私保护政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式客户/用户隐私政策或用户协议？ 是否披露个人信息收集和使用告知、最小必要原则及用户授权机制？ 用户能否撤回同意、注销账户、访问、更正或删除个人信息？ 是否采用数据加密、脱敏或访问控制？ 数据留存与销毁时限如何规定？ 第三方共享及SDK如何审核和约束？ 隐私事件响应、补偿、外部认证及覆盖范围是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视信息安全”；仅有网络安全防火墙描述；仅有员工个人信息内控；仅有ISO 27001证书而无隐私政策要点；区分：客户隐私保护政策关注个人信息收集使用共享与用户权利；网络安全风险管理关注攻击监测拦截与应急；治理指标关注董事会层面网络风险监督，不能互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: We respect the privacy of our customers, employees, business partners and other relevant individuals, and we strive to protect their personal identifiable information from abuse. Only where there is a legitimate business purpose is the personal data of individuals processed. In such an event, any processing of personal data shall be relevant to that business purpose and should be fair, accurate, transparent and in no way excessive. Employees are also expressly prohibited from compromising our or a third party's information and communication assets by, for instance, intentionally circumventing security measures to gain unauthorised access to systems or data; compromising any computer system; and creating an excess volume of messages.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Good Corporate Governance

[Content]
We respect the privacy of our customers, employees, business partners and other relevant individuals, and we strive to protect their personal identifiable information from abuse. Only where there is a legitimate business purpose is the personal data of individuals processed. In such an event, any processing of personal data shall be relevant to that business purpose and should be fair, accurate, transparent and in no way excessive. Employees are also expressly prohibited from compromising our or a third party's information and communication assets by, for instance, intentionally circumventing security measures to gain unauthorised access to systems or data; compromising any computer system; and creating an excess volume of messages.

results.text: Transition risks Changes in regulations | As China seeks to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060, many industries have been affected by new regulations such as energy efficiency benchmarks. As Home Control has manufacturing facilities in China, our manufacturing costs may increase as a result. Home Control frequently monitors the regulatory changes under current ISO14001 system requirements. Additionally, we conduct cross function assessments against the latest regulatory changes reported by third-party service agency such as SGS Hong Kong Limited. Changes in consumer expectations | There is a growing consciousness of environmental issues among consumers around the world. Accordingly, we may be affected by an increase in demand for environmentally- friendly products, and would need to ensure that we are well-positioned to turn this into a business opportunity. Currently, one of our key perpetual targets is to meet our customers' environmental requirements related to their products. Home Control has also dedicated an Environmental and Sustainability team to manage customer's environmental requirements on product level. Furthermore, a cross function 'Green Team' has been established for the study and implementation of environmentally friendly technologies and new materials on our product. Physical risks Extreme weather events | The sixth assessment report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has indicated that at the current rate of global warming, there would likely be an increased frequency of extreme weather events. For Home Control, this could mean potential disruptions in our supply chains. With regards to the management of supply chain disruption risks due to extreme weather events, Home Control has implemented/in the process of implementing the following: • Contingency plans to buffer from the effects of sudden bad weather events. The addition cost of production from contingency plan will be included in the Bill of Materials (BOM). • Supply risks assessment and tracking system that has been developed to help monitor and detect abnormal situation.

results.text: We are headquartered in Singapore, with regional sales and liaison offices in the United States ('US'), Belgium, the People's Republic of China ('China' or 'PRC'), Brazil, India and Taiwan. We keep our supply chain asset-light by outsourcing our product assembly process to eight manufacturing partners across China and Cambodia. This has allowed us to concentrate our resources on research and development ('R&D'), quality control, and sales management for our customers. Our R&D centres are located in Singapore and Suzhou, China. Currently, the Group has over 200 invention patents, maintains one of the two most comprehensive infra-red ('IR') and code databases in the world, and has been awarded the Technologically Advanced Service Enterprise Certificate from the People's Government of Suzhou Municipality in China.
